title: An abstaining cognition step asks the one founder decision that would let it answer
statement: Model-authored normalization, not founder words. This is the first capability dividend owed under INTENT-20261019-UPWARD-ASCENT. When GREG's cognition abstains on a signed mission step, a typed resolution on the receipt becomes exactly one founder ask of an existing kind.
